$comment: Copy to ~/.askanswer/settings.json (user) or .askanswer/settings.json (project). Local overrides: .askanswer/settings.local.json (gitignored). Precedence: process env > local > project > user > .env (lowest baseline). Loaded lazily on first use, never at import time. Optional first-class keys not shown: db_dsn (SQLAlchemy URL for the SQL subagent), db_dialect, tenant_id. Omit keys you do not use: empty strings are exported as empty env vars.
